title: I Let the Gym Sauna Minute Limit Hit the Trainer Who Lectured

parts.text: I sat in the sauna at 7:12 p.m. with the fifteen-minute sand timer the trainer, Jax, had installed after a memo about hogging. He stayed. He lectured a new member about protein. I was thirty, membership card wet from the pool. At minute sixteen I did not move, because Jax had not flipped the timer. He told me I was over. I pointed at the unflipped sand. Then I started the timer for him. At 7:29 the front desk camera, which he had requested for safety, showed him still talking at minute seventeen of his own sand.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The camera he requested has him past his own sand.

social.video_title: He installed the timer and ignored the sand — Part 1/2
social.description: Protein lecture, wet card, unflipped glass. Desk camera rolling. Would you have flipped it for him?

parts.text: Front desk asked Jax to cycle out. He did, red. The memo stayed. Fifteen meant fifteen. I finished a real fifteen later. Protein can wait in the lobby. Sand is older than trainers. The camera still does safety. I rinse. I sit. I leave when the glass does. Hogging is a lecture you should not give while hogging. Membership includes heat, not sermons.

social.video_title: Fifteen meant fifteen for the installer too — Part 2/2
social.description: Cycled out, memo intact, later heat. Was protein a minute?
